title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders 'Heavily Skewed' Towards PS5, Xbox Exec Responds
summary: Sony reportedly dominating biggest game of the generation
text: GTA 6 Pre-Orders 'Heavily Skewed' Towards PS5, Xbox Exec Responds | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 Pre-Orders 'Heavily Skewed' Towards PS5, Xbox Exec Responds Sony reportedly dominating biggest game of the generation by Sammy Barker 10 hours ago Share: Image: Push Square Update [ Fri 25th Sep 2026, 12:30am ]: Xbox executives love nothing more than posting on social media, so it was only a matter of time before one of the C-suite responded to Tom Warren’s article. Reacting to The Verge’s (paywalled) claim that GTA 6 pre-orders are heavily skewed towards the PS5, CSO Matthew Ball said the Redmond firm is “very happy” with how the title is performing on its platform. Tom, we are very happy with GTA VI pre-orders. The title is breaking records for XBOX, we expect even more records will be broken throughout the fall, and our internal analysis shows our share of pre-orders to be matching our share of the console market. - Matthew Ball (@ballmatthew) September 24, 2026 He wrote : “The title is breaking records for Xbox, we expect even more records will be broken throughout the fall, and our internal analysis shows our share of pre-orders to be matching our share of the console market.” It’ll be interesting to see if we ever get any receipts on this, but right now only Rockstar and the two platform holders will know which way the wind is blowing. Original Story: Sony is spending an obscene amount of money to make sure GTA 6 “feels” like an exclusive – and it’s working, apparently. A new report from The Verge (paywalled) digs into the larger dramas occurring at Xbox of late, including its massive layoffs and restructuring. (I wrote a little bit about how the platform feels like it’s being swallowed by Activision and Bethesda through here .) But there’s one interesting tidbit in the article that jumped out to me: “Sources at Xbox tell me that GTA 6 pre-orders are heavily skewed toward PS5, ringing yet more alarm bells about the platform.” This article has been written by Tom Warren, who’s remarkably well-connected with Microsoft, so I believe the reporting. It would be interesting to know just how skewed the pre-orders are, though. Obviously, Sony has a massive install base advantage over Microsoft anyway, with the PS5 approaching 100 million units sold compared to the Xbox Series X|S’ estimated ~35 million. Therefore you’d expect a difference of roughly 3:1 in the pre-orders, but I wonder if Sony’s marketing is skewing things even more heavily in the PS5’s favour. That would certainly be enough to set alarm bells ringing in Redmond. I wonder if we’ll ever get data on this. I’m sure Alinea will put out some predictions, but I can’t see Rockstar commenting on this. I expect PlayStation’s marketing alliance is going to get even more aggressive once GTA 6’s TV ads start airing closer to release, so I imagine you’re going to see those pre-orders continue to slide even more aggressively in Sony’s favour.
